description: GPU time-slicing between the CUDA context and the Hyprland compositor on the display GPU (RTX 5090 drives a 3840x2160 60 Hz monitor). Round-3 measurements; all diagnostic code has been removed.

environment.compositor: Hyprland 0.56.2 (blur 3 passes, color management on, hyprsunset running)
environment.gpu_pstate_under_cuda_load: P1, memory 13801 MHz of 14001 MHz max, SM 2400 MHz, no throttle reasons
environment.fngine_worker_cpus: 0-11 (one per physical core); engine thread CPU 12, n-gram I/O CPU 18

standalone_stall_detector.method: one CUDA thread spinning on %globaltimer for 1-3 s; a gap > 3 us means the context was not executing

in_context_watchdog_during_decode.method: one-thread kernel on a side stream of the fngine process, gaps > 10 us

decode_with_hyprland_paused.command: FNGINE_NO_ROUTING_STATS=1 build-main/apps/fngine-validate --pack /mnt/data/fngine/pack --ref /mnt/data/fngine/ref --golden g1 --expert-vram-mib 22000 --no-adaptive --decode-width W --timing --limit 256 (Hyprland SIGSTOPped only while the timed steps ran; arms interleaved)

handoff_microbenchmark.method: GPU writes a host-mapped flag, a pinned CPU thread answers, GPU polls with ld.acquire.sys; extra CTAs poll the same host line
handoff_microbenchmark.consequence: the decode and prefill combines now poll done[l] from one thread per launch and relay it through device memory
